name: fork-session-branching
brief: Fork a Pod at its current state into a new Pod tab. T1 first verifies, live, that the SDK's standalone forkSession behaves as documented against the CLI the product drives; every other task depends on it, and a refutation stops the session at an escalation whose fallback is the resume + forkSession:true option. T2 adds migration 5 (forked_from_pod_id with ON DELETE SET NULL, forked_from_cc_session_id) and an atomic EventStore.forkPod that copies the parent's lanes and events up to the fork point with ids remapped. T3 adds PodManager.forkPod over an injected SDK port, a shared forkEligibility rule (closed/idle/beached with a session id), and the pod:fork IPC channel with CONFLICT/IO errors. T4 adds a Fork control to each Pod tab that selects the new tab, states why it is unavailable, and shows a fork's ancestry.
